facts.material: polyimide insulated flexible substrate with copper runs, gold edge fingers, two non-printed connectors
facts.form: flexible circuit assembly fitted with connectors

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8534 printed circuits; chapter 85 note defines printed circuits and excludes circuits combined with elements other than those obtained in the printing process
GRI 1: heading 8544 insulated conductors fitted with connectors; heading 8536 connectors considered

rejected_alternatives.reason: flexible printed circuits, but chapter note excludes circuits combined with non-printed connectors
printed circuit connector; the article is the interconnect with connectors attached, not a connector alone
no control or switching function described

missing_facts: end use of the circuit (what apparatus it connects)
whether the connectors are merely mounted or integral to the printed process
classification.rationale: Chapter 85 note excludes from 8534 circuits combined with non-printed elements such as connectors, so this flex circuit with two connectors behaves as a flat interconnect cable fitted with connectors (8544.42). No tool-result ruling matched the same goods (I82726 is an inter-connector of rubber and brass wire) so none is cited.
